WELCOME.title: Welcome
WELCOME.text: Buy USDT for hryvnia low and sell it back high — the difference is yours. A quick tour shows where everything is.

BALANCE.title: Your balance
BALANCE.text: USDT you can spend right now. While a sale runs, the part staked in it shows as frozen and comes back when the sale finishes.

TRUST.title: Trust level
TRUST.text: It rises with your turnover and decides only one thing: how many sales you can run at once. Nothing to do here yet.

DEPOSIT.title: Top up
DEPOSIT.text: Add USDT by a crypto transfer (TRC20) or by a hryvnia transfer from your card. The rate under the button is what you pay per USDT.

SELL.title: Sell
SELL.text: Two ways to sell USDT: into a jar — paste its link and payers fill it with hryvnia; or straight onto your card — then you confirm each payment yourself. The rate under the button is what you get per USDT: more than you paid.

ACTIVITY.title: Your activity
ACTIVITY.text: All your top-ups and sales appear under these tabs with their status. The round button beside them opens your earnings.

NAV.title: Referrals and settings
NAV.text: Invite friends and earn a share of each of their sales. Settings hold the language — and this tour, whenever you want it again.

rules.title: Hryvnia top-up rules
rules.one_at_a_time: One top-up at a time: you cannot start another until the current one is finished.
rules.banks: Accepted banks: payment is taken from MonoBank and PrivatBank cards only.
rules.amount: Order amount: choose only an amount you can pay in full.
rules.exact: Exact amount: the transfer must match the order to the kopeck.
rules.timing: {{minutes}} minutes for everything — the transfer and the receipt. After that a receipt is no longer accepted and an appeal is all that is left.
rules.no_screenshots: Proof: screenshots of a transfer are not accepted — a full receipt is required.
rules.overpayment: Overpayment: anything transferred above the order amount is not credited.
rules.rejected: A receipt that fails the check does not cancel the top-up — it goes to an operator for review.
rules.crediting: Crediting: once the receipts pass, the USDT is credited to your account.
rules.warning: Breaking these rules can cost you your money.

fiat.fee_note: Send exactly this amount. If there is a fee for the transfer or for receiving it, send the money together with the fee — that will be your own cost, as the system credits the order’s amount.
fiat.our_fault: We could not load the amounts — that is a fault on our side. We are sorry, and we are on it.

guide.title: How to create the jar and get the link
guide.link_example: The link should look like this:
guide.goal_rule: The jar target must be EXACTLY this, or the order will be blocked:

MONO.step_1: In monobank open «Накопичення» and tap «Відкрити Банку» to create a jar.
MONO.step_2: In «На що накопичуємо у гривні?» enter «Оплата за послуги» (or «Оплата за товари») and tap «Продовжити».
MONO.step_3: In «Бажана сума накопичення?» enter the amount from the box above — exactly, to the kopeck. Do not tap «Пропустити».
MONO.step_4: The jar description can be skipped — it changes nothing.
MONO.step_5: On the jar page tap «Поділитися Банкою».
MONO.step_6: Under «Реквізити для поповнення» copy «Посилання на Банку» into the link field, and «Номер картки Банки» into the card number field.
MONO.warning: The card number must be the «Номер картки Банки» from that screen, not your personal card. With the wrong number every order expires and the order — along with the jar — gets blocked.

PRIVAT.step_1: In Privat24 open «Конверти» and tap «Створити Конверт».
PRIVAT.step_2: Pick UAH, set «Назва» to «Оплата за послуги», and set «Сума збору» to the amount from the box above — exactly. Tap «Продовжити».
PRIVAT.step_3: On the envelope page check that «Мета» equals the required amount, then tap «Поділитися».
PRIVAT.step_4: Copy «Посилання для поповнення» into the link field, and «Номер картки конверта» into the card number field.
PRIVAT.warning: The card number must be the «Номер картки конверта», not your personal card. With the wrong number every order expires and the order — along with the envelope — gets blocked.

PUMB.step_1: In PUMB open «Накопичення» and tap «Відкрити МаніБокс».
PUMB.step_2: In «Збираю» enter «Оплата за послуги» (or «Оплата за товари») and tap «Продовжити».
PUMB.step_3: In «Хочу зібрати» enter the amount from the box above — exactly. PUMB marks it optional; for this order it is not.
PUMB.step_4: Check the details and tap «Відкрити МаніБокс».
PUMB.step_5: On the moneybox page tap «Поділитись МаніБоксом».
PUMB.step_6: The description can be skipped — tap «Продовжити».
PUMB.step_7: Copy the link (mobile-app.pumb.ua) into the link field, and «Скопіювати номер картки» into the card number field.
PUMB.warning: The card number must be that moneybox’s own card, not your personal card. With the wrong number every order expires and the order — along with the moneybox — gets blocked.
PUMB.fallback: If the link is not recognised: open the moneybox in a browser and copy the address from the address bar — it must contain box_id.

NOVAPAY.step_1: In the NovaPay app open «Накопичення», find the «Кейс» block and tap «Створити кейс».
NOVAPAY.step_2: Name the Case «Оплата за послуги» (or «Оплата за товари») — do not keep a suggestion like «На відпочинок». The description can be skipped. Tap «Продовжити».
NOVAPAY.step_3: Pick the «Із цільовою сумою» type and enter the amount from the box above under «Вкажи розмір Кейсу» — exactly, to the kopeck. «Без цільової суми» will not do: with no goal there is no order. Tap «Створити Кейс» and give it a few seconds.
NOVAPAY.step_5: Copy the link from the «Закинути на Кейс за посиланням» row and paste it into the link field. There is no need to copy the card number — it fills itself in.
NOVAPAY.warning: The card number comes from the Case itself — you do not type it. The Case has to stay open and its goal has to match the amount above exactly, or the order is blocked.

sale.goal_mismatch: Your jar target is {{actual}} ₴, but it must be {{required}} ₴. Fix the target in your bank and paste the link again.
sale.stop_confirm: Stop it? Tap again to confirm
sale.stop_hint: Your frozen USDT returns to your balance. No profit is earned.
sale.stop_hint_winding_down: One transfer is still on its way. You can stop, but the sale settles once that payment closes — there is no refund figure to quote yet.

sale.remainder_label: What to do with the remainder
sale.remainder_wait_desc: The sale finishes only once the jar reaches its full goal.
sale.remainder_wait_desc_card: The sale finishes only once you have received the full amount down to the last hryvnia. An operator sends the last transfer, and you confirm it on the sale screen.
sale.remainder_refund_title: Return the remainder to my balance
sale.remainder_refund_desc: If less than ₴{{amount}} is left to reach the goal, that amount comes back to your balance in USDT at the sale rate and the sale completes successfully right away.
sale.tail_why: This is all that is left to reach the target. The payment system will not route an order this small, so the last transfer is sent by an operator by hand.
sale.tail_announced: An operator has been asked to send this transfer. The order appears here as soon as somebody takes it on.
sale.tail_taken: An operator has taken this transfer on and is sending it by hand.
sale.tail_hold: The sale can no longer be finished early. If the transfer never arrives, write to support and the remainder will be returned to you as USDT.
sale.tail_awaiting_statement: Send the statement for the payment you marked short first. Until it has been through, this figure may still be corrected, so nobody is asked to transfer it yet.
sale.card_mismatch: This card number is not the one the link pays into. Copy the jar’s card number from its share screen.
sale.card_verified: ✓ The card number matches the link
sale.card_awaiting_link: The card number is filled in automatically from the envelope link
sale.card_not_disclosed: The bank did not return a card number for this link. Check the link and try again.
sale.goal_use_suggested: Use {{amount}} USDT — exactly the jar’s goal
sale.rate_use_current: The rate moved — update the amount to {{amount}} USDT
sale.awaiting_jar_desc: The sale is finished; the jar is not. While it is open the slot stays taken. Close it in your banking app and the slot is released automatically.
sale.limit_blocked_by_jars: Your level allows {{max}} sales at once, and {{jars}} of those slots are held by finished sales whose jars are still open. Close the jar and the slot comes back.
sale.card_unavailable: Selling to a card is unavailable right now.
sale.card_number_hint: The card the money will reach.
sale.rate_moved: The rate moved — the amount has been updated.
sale.card_order_confirm_hint: Only confirm once you can see the money on your card. One payment can arrive as several transfers — wait for all of them.
sale.card_statement_hint: A PDF statement from the bank covering this payment. A screenshot will not do — we verify the bank’s signature.

card_guide.title: How this works
card_guide.step_split: The total is split into several payments — each payer sends their part separately.
card_guide.step_payer: The money arrives straight on your card. As soon as a payment is routed to you, we say so — in the app and in the bot.
card_guide.step_confirm: Once you see the money on your card, confirm the payment. The next one is only routed after that.
card_guide.step_statement: If a payment's time runs out and nothing arrived, tap «Nothing arrived» and send a PDF statement. We check the bank's signature ourselves.
card_guide.warning: Only confirm what you can actually see on your card.

sale.card_order_deny_locked: «Nothing arrived» becomes available once the payment is overdue.
sale.card_number_invalid: Check the card number — one of the digits looks wrong.
sale.card_order_amend_hint: Add up every transfer for this payment and enter the total. If it is far short we will stop further payments and ask for a statement. We will ask for one at the end either way, to check the figures; until then the remainder stays frozen.
sale.card_checkpoint_hint: You said one of the payments arrived short. Send a PDF statement for the card — we will check the amounts and release the remainder to your balance. Until then it stays frozen.
